title: Night Market Event Pack
tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

faults.what: The story image is approximately 3:5 rather than the requested 9:16, so it needs resizing or reframing.
The reel includes unsolicited, unrelated speech: “这是我的家乡。” (“This is my hometown.”), which does not promote the supplied event.

judge.summary: The pack has coordinated lantern imagery and clear, accurate event text, but the story has the wrong aspect ratio and the reel contains unrelated speech.

must_haves.item: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
must_haves.why: Three separate assets are shown, and the poster and reel match their requested proportions, but the story is approximately 3:5 rather than 9:16.

must_haves.item: All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
must_haves.why: All three share glowing golden lanterns, a midnight-blue market scene and consistent white text over dark translucent panels.

must_haves.item: Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
must_haves.why: All five supplied details are present and correctly spelled in both images and every sampled reel frame.

must_haves.item: The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds, and the market scene visibly changes position and framing across the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.
must_haves.why: The text is large, high-contrast and unclipped; the same complete event details remain visible from 1.3 through 8.8 seconds in the reel samples.
